test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a symbolic language, 'surat is a hot place' is written as 'a hot is place surat' and 'water vapour to air here', as 'to air vapour here water', then in the same language, 'shimla is a hill place' would be written as?
solution:
The logic is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b880ea7b24a3d82811258df3840bbe152d058ddb62e238d8afad402c194a10a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f067109f5d714f2182d71879030a779ad18e5628777dc02e336ae913652f3733.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77e511c7deb674dea09d5bcd164939e44dca31891f73b9ab7854908186f53c97.png] 

Hence, ‘**A hill is place shimla**’ is the correct answer.
